Container.Name: ChatGPT-Community
Container.Overview: Docker packaging for the upstream ChatGPT Community app. Standard: just the app, with persistent appdata. Optional: map selected folders or enable GPU acceleration. Advanced: optional SSH access for server administration; follow the setup steps under Additional Requirements below. WebUI login is optional; keep access on a trusted LAN/VPN.
Container.Requires:
No extra requirements for normal app use. SSH is OPTIONAL.
**Optional SSH setup for Unraid**
1. On your Unraid server, open Settings → Management Access. Set Use SSH to Yes and note the SSH port (normally 22). Apply only if changed. Keep SSH on your trusted LAN/VPN; do not forward it to the internet.
2. Switch this container form to Advanced View. Set Advanced: provision host SSH to true, SSH host to your server's reachable LAN IP/hostname (not localhost), SSH user to root, and SSH port to the port above.
3. Finish any active app tasks, then click Apply. This recreates the container and interrupts its running sessions. Setup creates missing keys/config only; it does not grant access yet.
4. Open this container's Logs from the Docker tab. Copy the complete public-key line beginning with ssh-ed25519. Under Users → root → SSH authorized keys, add it on a NEW line without removing existing keys, then Save. Never copy or share the private key.
5. Verify the server's SSH host-key fingerprint as explained in the guide below. Open this container's Console and test: [code]su -s /bin/sh abc -c "ssh server 'hostname; id'"[/code]. A successful check shows your server's name and uid=0(root).
**Important:** authorizing root gives the app full control of your server. Privileged mode and the Docker socket are not needed. Existing SSH config/keys are preserved; changing these fields does not replace an existing connection, and setting provisioning back to false does not revoke access. Older configs may use the alias unraid instead of server.
[a href="https://github.com/jeffreymooiweer/ChatGPT-Community-Docker/blob/main/docs/server-access.md#unraid-setup" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"]Full SSH guide, verification and troubleshooting[/a]

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Keep the existing path to preserve login, pairing and SSH keys

Config.Name: Optional: shared folder
Config.Description: Leave blank for app-only mode. Select one folder to make it available at /workspace/files (read-only by default). Change Access Mode to Read/Write only if the app may edit/delete files.

Config.Name: WebUI username (optional)
Config.Description: Only used when a WebUI password is set; unrelated to your ChatGPT account

Config.Name: WebUI password (optional)
Config.Description: Leave blank for no WebUI login (trusted LAN/VPN only). Set a strong unique password to enable login.

Config.Name: Wayland
Config.Description: Use Wayland/labwc; false selects the single-app X11 fallback

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: Advanced: provision host SSH
Config.Description: Optional. See Additional Requirements above for setup. true creates missing keys/config only; authorize the public key separately. false does not revoke existing access.

Config.Name: Advanced: SSH host
Config.Description: For new SSH setup only: enter the reachable server LAN IP/hostname, not localhost. Existing SSH config is preserved. Not needed for normal app use.

Config.Name: Advanced: SSH user
Config.Description: Account on the target server; only used for a new SSH config. Root grants full host control once authorized; choose a restricted account where supported.

Config.Name: Advanced: SSH port
Config.Description: Target SSH port; only used for a new SSH config.
